**Summary:** End-to-end probe roundtrip p99 of cluster <kafka_cluster> is above 2 s

Producing (acks=all) and consuming a probe message takes more than 2 s for 1 % of the probes. Look for slow produce requests, ISR problems and GC pauses.

## Impact

Producing and consuming takes seconds for a share of messages: latency-sensitive applications breach their SLOs.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · End-to-End Probe → produce latency per partition (slow leader?), then Broker Deep Dive request breakdown and JVM GC pauses.

## Mitigation

- Fix the slow broker (resources, disk, GC).

## Expression

```promql
kafka:e2e_roundtrip_latency_seconds:p99_rate5m > 2
```
